description: Batch prefill and extend for Grok-2 attention at TP8 (8 query heads, 1 KV head, head 128, soft cap 30) on a 16-token paged cache: fresh prompts from 1k to the 128k maximum context, batches filling 8k-16k-token prefill budgets, a chunked-prefill continuation and prefix-cache hits (new tokens on a cached prefix, kv_len > qo_len). Query and prefix lengths within a batch are deterministic pair offsets around qo_len and kv_len - qo_len (inputs.py). Short prompts, short extends and small batches finish below the 10 us timing floor and are correctness-only.
